In the galvinizing shop and the grinding and polishing shop there are four acid resisting vessels, each of 400 liters capacity, and three grinding machines. The equipment of the precision workshop is not known, 6. Work in the.shops was carried on in three eight-hour shifts, each of.about 350 prisoners. During 1950-51 the production consisted mainly of beds and cooking vats for military barracks.
